risk_if_not_implemented: Without Social Engineering & Mining, personnel are more likely to make unsafe decisions, fall victim to social engineering, mishandle data or violate requirements. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to System / Data Compromise (Non-Technical Vector) (R-BC-5), Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), Lack of a security-minded workforce (R-SA-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Workforce Shortage / Loss of Critical Skills / Labor Disruption (MT-25).

compensating_control_1.name: Security, Compliance & Resilience Knowledge Sharing
compensating_control_1.description:
Mechanisms exist to improve knowledge sharing across security, compliance and resilience personnel allowing for:
(1) Efficient operations; and
(2) Rapid and effective response to incidents.
compensating_control_1.justification: Security, Compliance & Resilience Knowledge Sharing (SAT-12) provides personnel training and awareness that compensates for the absence of Social Engineering & Mining (SAT-06.1) by reducing human-factor risk by equipping personnel to recognize and respond to relevant threats. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
